rows.grounds: genitive pronoun referring to the person described in the preceding verses
compound denoting fulfillment of every purpose or desire
fused form containing syāt (optative of as), yadi (if), yat (whatever), and manasi (in-mind); internal sandhi preserved in one token
verb indicating what abides or arises in the mind

items.question: What extent of desired accomplishment is assured for that qualified person?
premises: That person is the subject of the preceding auspicious results.
Whatever desire exists in that person's mind is taken as the condition.
Accomplishment of all aims is stated as possible for that person.
items.inference: Therefore, that person may attain fulfillment of every aim present in the mind.
uncertainties: The fused token syādyadyanmanasi is analyzed as syāt+yadi+yat+manasi, but the exact sandhi resolution of yat/manasi is compacted in the transmitted form.
items.plain_english: For him there may be accomplishment of all aims, whatever exists in his mind.
